rules: Use JetBrains Mono for all tickers, prices, percentages, financial data, and logs.
Never use Inter, Syne, or Roboto for headings.
Headings should use tracking-tight for a dense, professional look.
Line height must be tight (leading-none) for data blocks and loose (leading-relaxed) for the daily market summary paragraphs.
Never use pure black (#000000). Always use tinted void black (#050505) for the application background.
Use signal_buy (#10B981) and signal_sell (#EF4444) explicitly for up/down market data, chart candles, and PnL metrics.
Avoid teal (#1B93A4) or purple. Stick to strict technical colors (blue, green, red, amber) suitable for day trading.
Use border-collapse style layout for data tables and logs.
Grid children must stretch to match neighbors using h-full.
Limit border-radius to 4px (rounded-sm) or 8px (rounded-md) max. The interface must look like a precise terminal.
North Star metrics (e.g., Portfolio Balance, Active PnL, IBOV index) must be in the top-left quadrant.

components.cards: Flat solid background with 1px border (border-white/10). No glassmorphism. No heavy drop shadows.
components.charts: TradingView lightweight-charts for main price action. Must support overlays for RSI, MACD, and Bollinger Bands.
components.tables: Dense rows, sticky headers, monospaced numeric columns. Use Shadcn Table component customized for compactness.
components.buttons: Sharp corners, high contrast active states. Explicitly define hover states with higher contrast.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: Explicit text color changes and subtle background brightness shifts. Always set focus rings.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Fast, precise micro-interactions (duration-150 ease-out). No bouncy animations.

image_urls.description: Minimalist geometric bull logo for the application header.
Abstract dark geometric mesh background for empty trade journal or unselected states.

rules: All interactive elements and key informational metrics MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize the React application with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI.
Install Google Fonts: Chivo (headings), IBM Plex Sans (body), and JetBrains Mono (data/numbers).
Apply the dark theme explicitly by overwriting tailwind CSS variables with the colors specified in these guidelines (e.g., background, card, border).
Install `@phosphor-icons/react` for technical and UI icons.
Install `lightweight-charts` (TradingView library) for the professional candlestick chart interface. Construct it to handle overlays like RSI, MACD, and Bollinger Bands.
Implement the Dashboard structure using CSS Grid ('Control Room' mode). Ensure high data density without clutter.
Build the 'Trade Journal' component to log operations, utilizing a dense Shadcn Table with monospaced financial figures.
Build the 'Entry Signals Generator' logic/UI, parsing B3 asset data to trigger indications based on multiple indicators + volume.
Ensure YFinance and Brapi APIs are integrated on the backend/frontend for near real-time B3 quotes. Implement a fallback mechanism between them.
Include a 'Daily Market Summary' section for macro trends.
Apply `data-testid` to all forms, charts, tables, asset recommendations, and buttons for automated testing.
